title: How One Carbon Atom Powers Your Brain

teenKit.tldr: Forget the old idea that your body is a blunt furnace burning food into smoke; brain metabolism is actually a hyper-precise microscopic economy where every single carbon atom is tracked down to the millisecond.
teenKit.whyItMatters: Understanding how your brain tracks and deploys a single carbon atom reveals the exact biological mechanisms behind thought, memory storage, and even the hijacking of cells by deadly diseases.
keyTakeaways: Metabolism isn't a mindless fire destroying toast; it's a meticulously regulated transit system.
The currency of the brain's cellular economy is carbon, with every single atom tracked, diverted, or repurposed.
A single carbon atom from sugar can end up as an exhaled breath, a chemical message, a physical memory, or a driver of disease.

vocab.meaning: The complex chemical network inside your cells that transforms food into energy and building blocks.
A tiny biological vault deep inside the brain where sugar molecules are safely stored until needed.
The scientific study of the nervous system and how the brain's microscopic structures actually work.
A system of precise routing and transportation, much like how a city manages its supplies, but on a microscopic scale.
